# dsh-panes

A full-screen workspace panel for DeepSeek Harness: a
project sidebar on the left and, per project,

a set of tabs — session, files,
search, terminal, source control and notes.
一个 DSH 全屏工作台面板：左侧是项目列表，右侧是该项目的 tab 集合（会话、文件、搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理、笔记）。切换项目就切换整套 tab。

| Panel | `main` + `sidebar.panellist` row — one panel, opened from the DSH sidebar |
| Tabs | `sess

ion` · `file` · `explorer` · `search` · `terminal` · `git` · `notes` |
| Host | one same-origin `POS

T /dsh-panes/api` route, plugin-header fenced |
| Client | one bundled file (shadcn/ui + Tailwind, p

reflight off), React external |
| License | MIT |
## Tabs
| Tab | What it does |
| **Session** | A host conversation in the tab strip, one tab per session. A right dock holds **side

chats** — forks of the main conversation (`⌥S`). |
| **File** | Code view with syntax highlighting
(shiki), line numbers, breadcrumb, word wrap, `⌘G` jump-to-line, paged loading for large files, UTF-

8 detection — plus an inline editor (`⌘S` saves atomically, with etag conflict detection). |
| **Exp
lorer** | Tree on the left, its own internal tabs on the right, so browsing does not consume top-lev

el tabs. Sort by name, jump to top/bottom, reveal in the system file manager. |
| **Search** | Proje
ct-wide content search: regex, case sensitivity, globs, split result list + preview, hit counts, tru
ncation flag. Uses the machine's `rg`, then the `rg` bundled with `@vscode/ripgrep`, then a bounded

JS walk — and tells you which engine ran. |
| **Terminal** | A real pty in the tab, via the host's `

webTerminals` service, with fit-on-resize and live theme. |
| **Source control** | The Git tool wind
ow: changes, staged/unstaged, commit box, commit history graph, diffs, branch actions (16 rail butto

ns, each switchable), AI-generated commit messages. |
| **Notes** | A Notion-style Markdown vault: l
ist + BlockNote editor, one `.md` per note, frontmatter preserved by the host, `.trash` on delete, e
tag-based conflict detection. Notes live in one folder per project (`_inbox` for unassigned ones) an
d can be moved between projects. |
## What's new in 0.2.0

- **One type ladder** — every text step derives from `--wb-font-ui-size`, so the
`fontUiSize` config

field scales the whole panel (default is one step larger).
The status bar's light/dark label is now

a real toggle.
- **Notes per project** — each project gets its own folder in the vault, the list
an

d search are scoped to it, names come from the frontmatter everywhere
(list, tab, breadcrumb), and n

otes can move between projects or reveal in Finder.
- **Session tabs behave** — "new session" asks t

he host for a blank session
instead of reopening the first one, a history list sits in the `+` menu,

the
tab title follows the session's own title, and the scroll position survives a
tab switch.
- **S

plit view** — tabs can be split left/right or top/bottom, moved across panes,
and the split collapse

s when its pane empties.
- **Explorer became a split view too**: tree on the left, files in inner ta

bs on
the right, with sorting and jump-to-top/bottom buttons.
- **Tab actions** — rename inline (`F2

` or double-click), a right-click menu with
close ranges / copy path / reveal, batch close behind on

e confirmation, drag
reorder with a drop marker, and `⌥⌘←/→` to move the active tab.
- **The layout

lives in the host** — persisted through the plugin's own route
(`layout.json` in the DSH home), with

localStorage as the cache, so it comes
back after a port change or cleared site data. `⋯` → reset l

ayout if it ever
gets stuck.
- **Editable files** — the file tab has an inline editor that saves ato

mically
(`⌘S`) and refuses to clobber a file changed on disk (reload or overwrite).
- **Side chats**

— fork the current session into a dock on the right (`⌥S`),
several at a time, each its own convers

ation.
- **Browser tab removed** — Electron `<webview>` is gated by the host, so the
iframe could no
t open most sites; use the system browser.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then add `"dsh-panes"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`
and restart th

e client once — a new bundle is composed into the boot graph only on
restart. After that, rebuilds a
re picked up by a page reload.
The plugin shows up as the **Workbench / 工作台** row in the DSH sidebar.
From a checkout instead (development):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Uninstall: remove it from `dsh.profile.bundles`, then
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-panes`.
## Using it
- The sidebar lists every workspace with its open-tab count. `+` adds a project; the filter box narr

ows the
list; the collapse button shrinks the sidebar to a 52px rail (automatic below
820px of panel

width).
- `+` at the top right opens the **NEW TAB** menu: new session, open file,
explorer, search

, terminal, git, notes — then the project's recent sessions.
- Tabs can be split into two panes (sid

e by side or stacked) from the `⋯` menu;
each pane keeps its own strip, and a tab moves between pane

s from the same
menu. Double-click a tab to rename it, right-click for close-range, copy path
and re

veal; drag to reorder.
- Tabs are scoped to the project: switching project switches the whole tab se

t.
Each project's layout is persisted (in the host profile, so it survives a
port change or cleared

site data).
- The status bar shows branch + changed-file count (`±n`, click opens Git), the
project'

s open-tab count, cursor line/column, encoding, language, and a
light/dark toggle.
Keyboard (the panel only — a focused editor or terminal keeps its own keys):
| Keys | Action |

| `⌘P` / `Ctrl+P` | Quick open a file by name |
| `⌘⇧F` / `Ctrl+Shift+F` | Project search |
| `⌘⇧N`

| New session tab |
| `⌘W` | Close the current tab |
| `⌘⇧T` | Reopen the last closed tab |
| `⌘B` |

Collapse / expand the project sidebar |
| `Tab` / `⇧Tab` | Cycle tabs |
| `F2` | Rename the focused

tab |
| `⇧F10` | Tab context menu |
| `⌥⌘←` / `⌥⌘→` | Move the tab left / right |
| `←` / `→` | Mov

e focus between tabs |
| `⌥S` | Toggle the side-chat dock (session tabs) |
| `Esc` | Close the panel

focus between tabs |
| `⌥S` | Toggle the side-chat dock (session tabs) |
| `Esc` | Close the panel |
